notes.title: Testing Chamber Update (03/07/2025)
notes.content:
ADDITIONS:
Added Testing Chamber
- Completely new singleplayer mode.
- Survive for as long as possible.
- Beat your personal hi scores!
Added new multiplayer map: Dream

CHANGES:
- Protection bubble revamped.

BUGS FIXED:
- Left click can be held down to shoot again.
- Some other stuff probably.

[previewyoutube=1lMs6OkB1zE;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Password Recovery Update 07/14/2024
notes.content:
CHANGES:
- Changed how password recovery works. Everything is now automated. :)

notes.title: Cosmetics Update 07/12/2024
notes.content:
ADDITIONS:
Added 4 new player models
- Added panda model
- Added bear model
- Added pig model
- Added blank player model (used as a base for other models, but decided to include it as an actual player model, because why not)

Added 5 new hats
- Added pylon
- Added tophat
- Added 'other' tophat
- Added propeller cap (it spins!)
- Added tinfoil (yea.)

Added 2 new hands
- Added boxing gloves
- Added one deags

BUGS FIXED:
- Options menu Camera Zoom labeled correctly now
- Tutorial dialog ping is now included in Effects volume bus
- Koala model fixed (had 1 extra voxel)

notes.title: UI Update 7/9/2024
notes.content:
CHANGES:
* Redesigned a lot of the UI in menus and in-game.
- Complete redesign of leaderboard screen and account lookup.
- Redesign of colors used in UI.
- Complete redesign of options and server settings.

BUG FIXES:
- Emotes no longer play after death and after respawn.
- Discord RPC ghosting/hang fixed.
- Grenade launching now properly plays sound and animation for clients.
- Scoreboard card background in Nam's Garden fixed.
